hooks.command: p=$(grep -o '"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' | head -1); printf '%s' "$p" | grep -qE '[\/]src[\/].*\.(svelte|ts)"$' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"Sill is Rust-first, and this is a frontend file. Before writing logic here: could this operation live in Rust instead? Ranking, fuzzy matching, filtering, sorting, scoring, parsing, validation, caching, persistence, filesystem work, OS access and action resolution belong in src-tauri. Svelte owns DOM, styling, focus/hover/selection, and ephemeral interaction state. If you are adding domain logic here, say why it cannot live in Rust. Also: what does this cost at rest? No new timer or poll without saying why an event will not do. See CONTRIBUTING.md."}}' || true
